summary: Architect, partner at McKim, Mead & White, president of the National Academy of Design; John's 7th cousin 4x removed.
bio:
His cousin Lawrence Smith Butler (son of Cornelia Smith Butler), an architect, is also 7C4R. J. Lawrence Smith's other daughters Cornelia Smith Butler, Kate Wetherill and Ella Emmet (Gilded Age society figures) are 6C5R.

Son of Stanford White and Bessie Springs Smith: 6th cousin 4 times removed via Job Smith (one generation below Bessie), closer than the 7C4R on the site.

media.title: Wikipedia: Lawrence Grant White
media.note: Lawrence Grant White (September 26, 1887 – September 8, 1956) was an American architect, a partner in the architectural firm of McKim, Mead & White, co-founded by his father Stanford White, and for five years the president of the National Academy of Design.
